text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
K.S.Miracle didn't show up for training,
so while searching for her—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I don't read the magazines around here anymore,
so I'll just gather them up and... hm?"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"‘Fun Piano Songs!’, huh...
I kept it because there was a piece I wanted to learn, wasn't there?"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, I might end up leaving it lying around again,
so maybe I should start practicing right now—"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
La la la♪ La la la~♪
Hm hm hm♪ Hm hm hm~♪

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...Alright.
I should be able to memorize this quickly."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: I wonder if everyone will like it... Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Seeing that they were deeply remorseful,
I simply warned them to be more careful in the future.
